item_short_desc: Keep your identification tags silent and secure with Rothco’s Dog Tag Silencers. Designed to eliminate the clinking sound of metal tags, these silencers are made from durable, thick rubber that wraps around your tags to prevent any noise while you’re on the move. Perfect for those who prefer a quieter experience, these silencers are an essential accessory for anyone who wears identification tags regularly. Each set includes 2 silencers, making it easy to keep your tags protected. Please note dog tags & chains are not included.
description: Keep your identification tags silent and secure with Rothco’s Dog Tag Silencers. Designed to eliminate the clinking sound of metal tags, these silencers are made from durable, thick rubber that wraps around your tags to prevent any noise while you’re on the move. Perfect for those who prefer a quieter experience, these silencers are an essential accessory for anyone who wears identification tags regularly. Each set includes 2 silencers, making it easy to keep both of your tags protected. These silencers not only reduce noise but also provide added comfort by preventing the tags from rubbing against your skin. Whether you're looking for a practical solution for daily wear or a thoughtful gift for someone who frequently wears identification tags, Rothco's Dog Tag Silencers offer the perfect combination of functionality and comfort. Please note that dog tags and chains are not included.
